hooks.command: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.dart'); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then if command -v fvm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$staged" | xargs fvm dart format 2>/dev/null; else echo "$staged" | xargs dart format 2>/dev/null; fi; echo "$staged" | xargs git add; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running dart format on staged files...
